test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_join_limit (k String, a Array(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_join_limit SELECT toString(number), [repeat('x', 6000)] FROM numbers(50000)
